description: This file defines the class 'Image_Graph_Plotarea_Map' used for rendering map-based plots within the PEAR PHP Graph Rendering Utility. It handles map image loading, coordinate scaling, and plotting points on a map.

classes.name: Image_Graph_Plotarea_Map
classes.description: Class for creating map plot areas with geographic point plotting capabilities.

methods.name: Image_Graph_Plotarea_Map
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the map image and points from specified files.

methods.name: _fillLeft
methods.description: Calculates the left boundary of the fill area.

methods.name: _fillTop
methods.description: Calculates the top boundary of the fill area.

methods.name: _fillRight
methods.description: Calculates the right boundary of the fill area.

methods.name: _fillBottom
methods.description: Calculates the bottom boundary of the fill area.

methods.name: _pointX
methods.description: Returns the pixel X position for a geographic coordinate.

methods.name: _pointY
methods.description: Returns the pixel Y position for a geographic coordinate.

methods.name: addMappoint
methods.description: Adds a geographic point based on latitude and longitude.

methods.name: addPoint
methods.description: Adds a point with specified X and Y coordinates.

methods.name: _updateCoords
methods.description: Calculates scaling and positioning for the map and plot area.

methods.name: _done
methods.description: Renders the map image and points onto the canvas.
